configuration.mu_nu_tau_assumption: zero, following the published Blinov Appendix-B discussion of the unavailable tau-neutrino chemical-potential profile

equation_mapping.B10: Neutrino inverse-decay detailed balance: Gamma_prod = exp(-omega/T) Gamma_abs.
equation_mapping.B19: Compton detailed balance only; it is not the neutrino inverse-decay detailed-balance equation.
equation_mapping.B4: Reduced absorption: Gamma_star = (1-exp(-omega/T)) Gamma_abs = expm1(omega/T) Gamma_prod.
equation_mapping.B6: Direct two-body phase-space integral reduced to an angular average of fbar(E1;-mu_nu) fnu(E2;mu_nu).
equation_mapping.normalization: Using Gamma(V->nubar nu)=alpha_V mV/6 and alpha_V=g^2/(4 pi), B7 gives Gamma_prod/g^2 = mV^2 I/(8 pi omega) per neutrino flavor.
